candidates.title: Manual dosing setting reverts to automatic after the page is reloaded
candidates.description: A safety setting that the screen confirms ('now manual') should still show that state after a reload, so that what the screen says matches what the pumps will do. Currently, after the grower switches 'Automatic nutrient dosing' off, the status reads 'Nutrient dosing is now manual: the pumps run only when you start them.' After a reload of /, the switch is on again and the status reads 'Nutrient dosing is automatic: pumps A and B top up to EC 1.8.' Nothing on the page shows that the change was saved, such as a time of the switch or an entry in the recent pump events list.
candidates.impact: Growers draining the reservoir may trust the 'now manual' message while the shown state, and possibly the pumps, return to automatic. After a refresh of the shared tablet, or when a second grower checks the page, it may show automatic with no explanation, and the pumps may dose into an empty tank.

locations.snippet: Nutrient dosing is now manual: the pumps run only when you start them.

evidence.detail: click switch -> status 'Nutrient dosing is now manual: the pumps run only when you start them.' within 300 ms
click switch, expect 'now manual' (ok), goto / again, expect 'now manual' failed: saw 'Nutrient dosing is automatic: pumps A and B top up to EC 1.8.'

factor_notes.frequency: Every time the switch is used and the page is later reloaded or opened on another device. The setting is changed before each reservoir change on a shared tablet.
factor_notes.impact: Critical journey; the setting protects against dosing into an empty tank. The screen's confirmation and the shown state disagree after a reload.
factor_notes.persistence: Recurs on every reload; growers cannot learn their way around it.

candidates.recommendation: Keep the dosing mode in a stored source of truth, read it back on load, and show when it was last changed (for example 'Manual since 14:07'). Optionally, record the switch in the recent pump events list.
